title: Telecom core network
goal: Show redundant router and fibre paths within a core-network reliability path.

rubric.must: A left-to-right reliability path visibly represents telecom service success path.
The drawing visibly shows two router-and-fibre paths visibly arranged in parallel.
The drawing visibly shows access aggregation and peering edge as series blocks.
Every component block visibly displays its reliability value.
Input and output terminals visibly bracket the success path.
A computed system-reliability summary is visible on the drawing.
